newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-FREE STATE END CAMPAIGN IN STYLE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FREE STATE END CAMPAIGN IN STYLE.

text.p: Free State finished their Super 12 rugby campaign in style with an inspired 35-23 win over Northern Transvaal on Friday.

Free State ran in four first half tries and added a fifth in the second period to finish the series with five victories from 11 matches. Northerns responded with three tries of their own, but could not match the power and pace of the visitors.
Northerns were missing inspirational captain Adriaan Richter and their defensive pattern was unrecognisable from the one which earned a 27-all draw against Natal last week.
Free State captain Helgard Muller opened the scoring for his team in the second minute and Springbok flanker Andre Venter barged over for his side's second try in the 10th.
Winger Chris Badenhorst scored the first of his two tries in the 32nd minute when he squeezed over in the right hand corner and centre Brendan Venter got the fourth for his side late in the half.

Fly-half Jannie de Beer converted all four tries, while Northerns had only two penalties from Casper Steyn to show for their efforts until flanker Nicky van der Walt charged over from the base of a ruck in first half injury time.
The second half was played at a steadier pace, but Badenhorst's second try in the 60th minute settled the issue as he finished off a brilliant break by scrum-half Kat Myburgh.
Northerns scored consolation tries through replacements Matthys Bekker and Kobus Engelbrecht.

Northern Transvaal - Graeme Bouwer; Erik Kruger, Andre Snyman, Johan Schutte (Kobus Engelbrecht 78 mins), Casper Steyn; Boeta Wessels, Joost van der Westhuizen (captain); Jannie Brooks (Matthys Bekker 45 mins), Lourens Muller, Nicky van der Walt, Krynuw Otto, Derrick Grobbelaar, Mariur Hurter, Henry Tromp, Lourens Campher.

Free State - M.J.Smith; Chris Badenhorst (Jan-Harm van Wyk 78 mins), Helgard Muller (captain), Brendan Venter, Stephen Brink; Jannie de Beer, Kat Myburgh; Jaco Coetzee, Johan Erasmus, Andre Venter, Braam Els, Ryno Opperman (Charl van Rensburg 82 mins) Willie Meyer (Dougie Heymans 45 mins), Naka Drotske, Os du Randt (Willie Meyer 80 mins).
